summary: An algebra map O → ℂ_ℓ extends to ℚ̄_ℓ (O is algebraic over ℤ_ℓ, ℂ_ℓ algebraically closed and torsion-free over O), and every such extension is an element of G_ℓ.

steps.claim: Let φ : O → ℂ_ℓ be a ℤ_ℓ-algebra map; regard ℂ_ℓ as an O-algebra through φ.
ℚ̄_ℓ is algebraic over O (O is algebraic over ℤ_ℓ as a subring of ℚ̄_ℓ).
steps.lean: have := isAlgebraic_iff_top ℤ_[ℓ] O (A := PadicAlgCl ℓ).1 inferInstance

steps.claim: ℂ_ℓ is torsion-free over O (the action of ℤ_ℓ on ℂ_ℓ is faithful).
φ extends to an algebra map ℚ̄_ℓ → ℂ_ℓ (ℂ_ℓ algebraically closed); by exists_gp_eq_algHom this extension is x ↦ g(x) for some g ∈ G_ℓ, so φ = coeffEmb O g.
